stage: V28 transfer of frozen cheap waiting controls to the complete V25 panel
inputs: Read V25 selection.json, model_fit.json and city_transfer_endpoints.json.gz unchanged. All 73 roots, original20 and route_empirical20, 20-second grid, existing candidate/tail menus and ranks. No refitting, parameter search, new date or download.
primary_control: V27 SingleTargetOpportunity unchanged. Keep existing first-offer, one-step and schedule/combined alternatives to expose both gains and harms. No method is selected or patched using V28 outcomes.
primary_population: All 48 origin roots. Separately show the six V26/V27 construction origins and the remaining 42 origins, so the earlier six improvements cannot conceal transfer failures. Also split by date and timetable menu size (0, 1-5, 6-10, 11-18).
secondary_population: All 25 fixed-prefix first-transfer roots, including six empty menus. Replay the fixed prefix first. These are conditional states, not 25 additional independent full journeys.
execution: Reuse V25 physical_path, public_offers and execute: common 30-second publication, station MCT, 40-minute cap and first-opportunity downstream rescue. Known departure may inform a decision even if its arrival is missing; no invented cancellation or missing endpoint. Keep pre-entry unobserved mass in all model controls.
comparisons: Single-target versus one-step, first-offer and schedule priority; combined versus one-step and single-target. For each contrast report its own complete pairs, wins/harms/ties, actions, means and arrivals. Never compare unmatched known-only means as a treatment effect.
missingness: Preserve every frozen root. Each truncated unknown loss lies in [0, deadline-start]; use only these endpoints to bound all-root average gain, keeping the known arm's value. These are deterministic missing-data ranges, not confidence intervals. Report per-method status/known coverage and common intersections.
verification: Reproduce V25 first-offer and law-specific one-step actions, tails, losses, arrival flags and status at every root. Reproduce all three V27 new controls on the six construction roots under both laws. Independently test prefix/MCT execution and paired missing-data arithmetic.
cost: Like V25, share the per-day belief cache across roots. Record day graph/model preparation, menu conversion/prefix/public-offer preparation, nominal-score compilation, each cheap controller's incremental compilation, online choice and physical replay separately. Nominal preparation is shared infrastructure for alternative model arms, not a charge to schedule priority or first-offer. Do not call cached panel totals cold-root latency.
scope: Actual replay only; zero new random worlds, no reconstruction of old worlds, no 18-candidate subset DP or exact proxy-state enumeration. Earlier dates and outcomes have already been used in development: this is frozen-rule transfer within the project, not a new holdout.
decision: Assess the remaining 42 origins and conditional transfer states separately before attributing portability to the rule. Preserve any failure without adjusting thresholds or expanding budgets. Baseline portability is not an OR method claim or complete G2.
